about: Images of the 102 comparison cells of Taamey_D.html, rendered once, each from the font maker's TTF. Each image record names its font, whose record below holds the font's name-table facts and checksums. No grant is made or implied over the fonts, whose terms remain their makers', as each font's name table states.

shaping.buffer: the cell's whole text, spaces included

rendering.letter spacing: the page's .6rem (9.6px) at the cell's font size, rounded to whole font units, at the right of each cluster, where Chromium puts letter spacing in right-to-left text
rendering.horizontal pad: each image's ink, plus 0.02 em, stays within its font's pad; the stylesheet cancels the pad with negative margins
rendering.comparison: each cell was also rendered from the WOFF2 the page served, decompressed with fontTools, and the two SVGs compared
